Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

GeoCoordinates.description: GeoCoordinates represents a geographic location using WGS84 coordinates.

lang.description: ISO 639-1 language code (en, fr, ar, etc.)

variant.description: Site variant: full, tech, finance, happy

categories.description: Per-category buckets — keys match category names from feed config

feedAcquisitions.description: Per-feed acquisition outcomes and delivery, independent of legacy statuses.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this digest was generated

NewsAcquisition.description: NewsAcquisition records acquisition and delivery without inferred fetch times.

acceptedCount.description: Number of articles accepted after boundary validation.

acquiredAt.description: Genuine successful upstream acquisition time, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

attemptedAt.description: Actual upstream attempt time; absent when unknown, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

cacheStoredAt.description: Cache write time, never an acquisition surrogate, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

delivery.description: NewsDelivery identifies how the current articles were delivered.

outcome.description: NewsOutcome describes the latest acquisition attempt independently of delivery.

NewsItem.description: NewsItem represents a single news article from RSS feed aggregation.

isAlert.description: Whether this article triggered an alert condition.

publishedAt.description: Publication time, as Unix epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

NewsProvenance.description: NewsProvenance records article provenance independently of legacy dates.

acceptedCount.description: Number of articles accepted by the acquisition.

acquiredAt.description: Genuine successful upstream acquisition time, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

attemptedAt.description: Actual upstream attempt time; absent when unknown, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

cacheStoredAt.description: Cache write time, never an acquisition surrogate, in epoch milliseconds.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

delivery.description: NewsDelivery identifies how the current articles were delivered.

deliveryGroup.description: Configured delivery group: google-rss, rss-direct:hostname, gdelt, newsapi, newsdata, or unknown.

observedAt.description: Provider observation time, in epoch milliseconds; distinct from publication.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

outcome.description: NewsOutcome describes the latest acquisition attempt independently of delivery.

publicationState.description: NewsPublicationState separates publication truth from legacy scoring dates.

publishedAt.description: Valid raw publication time, in epoch milliseconds; absent when unknown.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

sourceId.description: Configured source identifier; distinct from publisher independence.

SummarizeArticleRequest.description: SummarizeArticleRequest specifies parameters for LLM article summarization.

geoContext.description: Geographic signal context to include in the prompt.

variant.description: Variant: "full", "tech", or target language for translate mode.

SummarizeArticleResponse.description: SummarizeArticleResponse contains the LLM summarization result.

cached.description: Whether the result came from Redis cache.

error.description: Error message if the request failed.

fallback.description: Whether the client should try the next provider in the fallback chain.

skipped.description: Whether this provider was skipped (credentials missing).

tokens.description: Token count from the LLM response.

ThreatClassification.description: ThreatClassification represents an AI-assessed threat level for a news item.

level.description: ThreatLevel represents the assessed threat level of a news event.

ValidationError.description: ValidationError is returned when request validation fails. It contains a list of field violations describing what went wrong.

get.description: ListFeedDigest returns a pre-aggregated digest of all RSS feeds for a site variant.

parameters.description: Site variant: full, tech, finance, happy
parameters.name: variant

parameters.description: ISO 639-1 language code (en, fr, ar, etc.)
parameters.name: lang
